name: total
sql: SELECT sum(ListCost) AS list_cost FROM finops_usage WHERE Tool = 'claude-code' AND Charge = 'usage' AND Day >= subtractDays(now(), 30)

name: daily
sql: SELECT Day AS day, sum(ListCost) AS cost FROM finops_usage WHERE Tool = 'claude-code' AND Charge = 'usage' AND Day >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
